Data Management
All your data is saved automatically. Last saved: —
☁ Automatic Backup — Google Drive + This PC
Two folders are kept in step: pick your Google Drive folder for folder 1 and a normal folder on this PC for folder 2. Every change is written to both automatically (Google Drive for Desktop uploads folder 1 to the cloud). Files written: RAMZ_WMS_AutoBackup.json (always the latest) and a dated daily copy.

Open the software on another PC and it reads the newest backup from these folders by itself on start — no manual import. If this PC already has older data, you are asked once before it is replaced.

⚠ Data Recovery — Copy from Old File
Step 1: Open your old HTML file in Chrome browser
Step 2: Press F12 → click Application tab → Local Storage (left panel) → click your file
Step 3: Find row with key ramz_wms_data → double-click the long value on the right
Step 4: Press Ctrl+A then Ctrl+C to copy all
Step 5: Paste below and click Recover My Data
